name: WorkBuddy Switch Next icon v4
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Redesign the PROVIDED ORIGINAL WorkBuddy Switch cat icon into a recognizable WorkBuddy Switch Next edition with MODERATE, CLEARLY VISIBLE changes. Preserve the beloved original mint-green cat identity, original front-facing cropped full-body composition, asymmetric softly pointed ears, two round blue eyes, tiny friendly blue smile, soft matte tactile material, warm ivory full-bleed background. The result must remain recognizably the same mascot, but easily distinguishable from the original even at thumbnail size. Make these cohesive changes: (1) replace the original stepped blue patch on the upper-right ear with a clean smooth cobalt-blue ear cap, covering the outer third of the ear, no staircase; (2) make the large curled tail on the LEFT a rich cobalt-blue ribbon-like tail with a turquoise transition only near its attachment, keeping its original sweeping S-shaped character and original approximate position, but give the tip a neat upward flick; (3) add a simple small warm-ivory oval belly/chest patch in the lower center of the green body, partially cropped by the bottom edge, giving the mascot a distinctive two-tone character. Remove the two little blue cheek squares entirely: a clean friendly face. Keep green as the dominant color, blue as a substantial secondary accent, ivory as background and chest. Balanced high-quality contemporary desktop app icon, original soft shading refined, no shiny plastic, no heavy gradients, no outline. Do not add any letters, N, words, arrows, chevrons, badges, objects, buttons, framing, rounded-square masks, borders, black corners or tiny decorations. Ivory fills the whole square canvas to all four edges. The blue tail and blue ear must be visually deliberate and harmonious, not pasted-on symbols. One finished icon, no mockup or comparison sheet.
integration: Preview candidate only; current application icons remain unchanged.
